zh.page_title: LiveCopilot — 你的 macOS 对话助手
zh.description: 原生 macOS 对话助手：本地语音识别、个人知识库检索和可以直接说出口的回答建议。支持中文与英文，自选 OpenAI、DeepSeek 或兼容分析服务。
zh.hero_title:
对话在继续，
思路跟得上。
zh.hero_intro: 听取对话，找回资料中的重点，把想法整理成可以直接说出口的回答。一个安静待在桌面边上的 macOS 助手。
zh.release_note: 开源社区版 1.3.2 · 自备分析服务 API Key
zh.demo_caption: 从一句提问，到一句有准备的回答
zh.demo_status: 示例对话 · 远程会议
zh.demo_question: 如果先上线一个小版本，你会保留什么？
zh.demo_reply: 我会先保留用户最常用的那条流程，让它从头到尾跑通。其他功能可以晚一点加。这样我们能更快拿到真实反馈，也能知道下一步该把时间花在哪里。
zh.demo_recap: 我们在讨论第一版的范围：先把核心流程做完整，再根据真实使用反馈决定后续功能。当前还需要明确第一批用户是谁。
zh.demo_followup: 如果第一版只能解决用户的一个问题，你觉得最值得先解决的是哪一个？
zh.demo_evidence: 示例资料：产品讨论笔记 · 回答中的一般建议属于合理延伸
zh.demo_input: 输入问题，无需开启监听
zh.demo_note: 点击按钮试试三种建议。这里使用预设示例，不录音、不调用 API。实际窗口可缩放、刷新，也能贴边隐藏。
zh.uses_title: 把注意力留给眼前的对话
zh.features_title: 资料在手边，表达更自然。
zh.features_intro: LiveCopilot 把正在发生的对话和你的资料放在一起，帮你接住问题，也接住下一句。
zh.quote: “我的理解是，先把核心流程跑通，再用真实反馈决定下一步。”
zh.quote_note: 先给能说出口的回答；需要时，把依据与补充放在后面。
zh.feature_one_body: 导入 PDF、Markdown、TXT 或 DOCX。回答时检索相关片段，并提供可展开的来源。也允许补充常识与合理推理，不编造个人经历。
zh.feature_two_title: 一个小窗口，跟着内容展开
zh.feature_two_body: 空白时保持紧凑，有文字后向下展开。可选毛玻璃、微透磨砂或白色底；固定在桌面，或在屏幕右边缘呼出。
zh.feature_three_body: 点一下刷新，清空当前转写、回答与上下文。正在监听时继续新的会话；知识库和已保存历史保留。
zh.services_title: 本地处理多少，由你选择。
zh.services_intro: 语音识别、资料向量化和回答分析分别配置。可以把前两项留在本机，只让 DeepSeek 等分析服务生成回答。
zh.local_tag: 本地 · 无 API 调用费
zh.paid_tag: 云端 · 自备 API Key
zh.apple_body: 系统原生流式识别，需要 macOS 26+ 和受支持的设备、语言。
zh.funasr_body: Paraformer 边说边更新中英字幕；SenseVoiceSmall + VAD 在语音分段结束后识别。
zh.speech_choice: 在你的声音、口音和设备上试用比较。本地流式字幕可能修正；自动建议根据完成的文本判断。
zh.cloud_speech_body: 实时转写与语义提问判断。
zh.cloud_speech_choice: 需要联网，会向 OpenAI 发送音频。适合希望使用云端实时语义判断的场景。
zh.embedding_body: BGE-M3 在本机生成向量；OpenAI Embeddings 在云端处理文本。检索数据库始终在本机。
zh.embedding_choice: 选本地模型可避免上传建库文本。切换向量模型后，需要重建索引以使用新的语义检索。
zh.analysis_body: 也支持提供流式 Chat Completions 接口的兼容服务。
zh.analysis_choice: 语音服务与分析模型互不绑定。分析服务接收问题、相关对话和检索片段，不会因此获得整个知识库。
zh.service_note: 本地免费指无 API 调用费，首次模型下载需要联网并占用磁盘，运行使用本机算力。云端费用由你自己的服务账户承担；应用设置提供带核对日期的价格说明。兼容服务的模型能力与计费方式由服务商决定。
zh.privacy_title: 知道什么留在本机，什么会发出去。
zh.privacy_intro: LiveCopilot 没有自己的账号体系，也不经过开发者的转发服务器。你选择的模型决定数据的处理位置。
zh.privacy_local_body: 选择本地 ASR 和 BGE-M3 后，语音识别、向量化和检索在 Mac 上完成。模型首次下载需要网络。
zh.privacy_cloud_title: 只在需要回答时发送相关文本
zh.privacy_cloud_body: 问题、所选对话上下文和相关资料片段发送到你配置的分析服务。选用云端语音或向量服务时，相应音频或文本也会发送给该服务。
zh.privacy_key_title: 密钥由 macOS 安全保存
zh.privacy_key_body: API Key 保存在本机 Keychain。启动时静默检查；需要授权时在服务页明确提示，不把密钥写进源码或日志。
zh.install_intro: 下载通用 DMG，拖入应用程序即可。无需安装 Python、Ollama 或开发工具。
zh.install_one: 退出旧版，将 LiveCopilot.app 拖入 Applications，保持安装位置固定。
zh.install_two: 打开设置，选择本地语音模型并下载，或配置 OpenAI Live。
zh.install_three: 选择分析服务并保存 API Key；需要时导入自己的资料。
zh.install_four: 开始监听并授予所需音频权限，或直接输入问题。Option + H 可唤出悬浮窗。
zh.signing_note: 当前为临时签名、未经 Apple 公证的社区版。核对来源与校验和后，按 Apple 的单应用“仍要打开”流程安装。签名变化的升级可能需要重新授权。
zh.credit_prefix: 基于原生 macOS 开源项目
zh.site_privacy: 此介绍页不使用分析追踪、外部字体或 Cookie。

en.description: A native macOS copilot with local speech recognition, personal knowledge retrieval, and answers you can say aloud. Bring your own OpenAI, DeepSeek, or compatible analysis service.
en.hero_title: Stay in the conversation. Find your next words.
en.hero_intro: Follow the conversation, bring your notes into focus, and get an answer you can say aloud. A quiet copilot at the edge of your Mac.
en.release_note: Open-source community build 1.3.2 · Bring your own analysis API key
en.demo_caption: From a question to a considered reply
en.demo_question: What would you keep if we shipped a smaller first version?
en.demo_reply: I'd keep the workflow people use most and make sure it works from start to finish. The other features can follow. That gives us real feedback sooner, so we know where to spend our time next.
en.demo_recap: We're discussing the scope of the first release: finish the core workflow, then use real feedback to prioritize what's next. We still need to decide who the first users will be.
en.demo_followup: If the first version could solve just one problem for users, which one would be most valuable?
en.demo_evidence: Example source: product discussion notes · General suggestions extend beyond the notes
en.demo_input: Ask a question, even with listening off
en.demo_note: Try the three buttons. This is a scripted example: no recording or API calls. The real window can resize, start fresh, or hide at the screen edge.
en.uses_title: Keep your attention on the conversation
en.features_title: Your notes, in words that feel like you.
en.features_intro: Bring the conversation and your own material together. Get a useful starting point for the question in front of you, and the next one.
en.quote: “I'd start by making the core workflow work, then use real feedback to decide what comes next.”
en.quote_note: A speakable answer first. Supporting evidence and notes follow when useful.
en.feature_one_body: Import PDF, Markdown, TXT, or DOCX files. Answers retrieve relevant passages with expandable sources, and can add general knowledge and reasoning without inventing your experience.
en.feature_two_title: A small window that grows with the thought
en.feature_two_body: Compact when empty; taller when words arrive. Choose glass, soft frost, or white. Pin it to the desktop, or reveal it from the right screen edge.
en.feature_three_title: A fresh start for the next conversation
en.feature_three_body: One refresh clears the current transcript, answer, and context. Active listening continues as a fresh session. Your knowledge base and saved history stay intact.
en.services_title: Choose what runs on your Mac.
en.services_intro: Configure speech, embeddings, and answer generation separately. Keep the first two local and let an analysis service such as DeepSeek write the answer.
en.apple_body: Native streaming recognition. Requires macOS 26+ and supported hardware and languages.
en.funasr_body: Paraformer updates Chinese/English captions as you speak. SenseVoiceSmall + VAD transcribes completed speech segments.
en.speech_choice: Compare using your own voice, accent, and hardware. Streaming previews can change; automatic suggestions use completed text.
en.cloud_speech_body: Realtime transcription and semantic question detection.
en.cloud_speech_choice: Requires a connection and sends audio to OpenAI. Useful when you want cloud-based realtime question detection.
en.embedding_body: BGE-M3 creates vectors locally; OpenAI Embeddings processes text in the cloud. The search database always stays on your Mac.
en.embedding_choice: Choose local embeddings to keep indexing text on-device. Rebuild the index after changing embedding models to use the new semantic search.
en.analysis_body: Also supports compatible services with a streaming Chat Completions API.
en.analysis_choice: Independent of your speech provider. The service receives the question, relevant conversation, and selected passages, not your entire knowledge base.
en.service_note: Local means no API usage fee. Initial model downloads require internet and disk space; inference uses your Mac's compute. Cloud usage is billed to your provider account. Settings include dated pricing notes. Compatible providers determine their own model capabilities and billing.
en.privacy_title: Know what stays local, and what leaves.
en.privacy_intro: No LiveCopilot account and no developer-operated relay server. Your service choices determine where content is processed.
en.privacy_local_body: With local ASR and BGE-M3 selected, recognition, embeddings, and retrieval run on your Mac. Model downloads need internet once.
en.privacy_cloud_body: Questions, selected conversation context, and relevant passages go to your analysis provider. Cloud speech or embedding options also send the corresponding audio or text to that provider.
en.privacy_key_body: API keys stay in your local Keychain. Startup checks silently; Services tells you when authorization is needed. Keys never go into source code or logs.
en.install_title: A little more prepared for your next conversation.
en.install_intro: Download the universal DMG and drag the app into Applications. No Python, Ollama, or developer tools needed.
en.download_details: 1.3.2 · Universal DMG · Free and open source
en.install_one: Quit the previous version and move LiveCopilot.app into Applications. Keep its installation location consistent.
en.install_two: In Settings, download a local speech model or configure OpenAI Live.
en.install_three: Choose an analysis service, save your API key, and optionally import your own material.
en.install_four: Start listening and grant the required audio permissions, or just type a question. Option + H shows the overlay.
en.signing_note: This community build is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized. Verify the source and checksums, then use Apple's per-app Open Anyway instructions. Updates with a changed signature may require renewed permission.
en.credit_prefix: Built on the native macOS foundation of
en.site_privacy: This site uses no analytics, external fonts, or cookies.
